notes: No string changed in stage 3. These are 95 interface strings (controls, labels, aria, one tagline, one 404 page); the localizer's levers (heat and season, day planning, hours, families, glossing of Arabic generics and UNESCO vocabulary) belong to running text, and the fence forbids adding any of them to a label. Emphasis and framing were checked string by string and nothing needed adapting.

Checked for Turkish-visitor fit and left as is: the 404 heading (a gentle, non-devotional image taken from the source); foot.tagline (no devotional or brochure-superlative wording); foot.independence (states the site is not an official body, which a Turkish reader should see plainly); det.unesco (no gloss: the UNESCO World Heritage vocabulary is known to this reader, and a gloss would be content, not a label); lang.suggest.* (wiring issue flagged in source_defects, not a wording issue).
Gloss rule (once per term, in body text, never in a heading or label) means El-Ahsa, 'Hasawi' cuisine and 'souq' get no explanation in any of these strings; the page bodies carry the gloss.

Religious wording checked: 'Camiler ve dinî yapılar' states what the source states (mosques and religious sites), with no devotional or dress/access framing added; 'cami' is not glossed (reader knows it).
facts_not_added: A best-season or heat note on det.bestTime or det.nearby.d (e.g. summer midday heat): not in the source, and det.bestTime is a bare label whose value comes from page data.
A walking-distance, shade or duration remark on det.distance, det.nearby.note or data.dist.*: the source says only 'approximate, in a straight line'.
A family-friendly emphasis on the categories or nav labels: only the Jabal Al-Qarah card says 'Families', as page data.

A gloss of the Arabic generic 'souq' on nav.leisure and CATEGORY_LABELS.market, or of 'Hasawi' on nav.food and CATEGORY_LABELS.taste: glosses are body-text only, once per page, and Turkish 'çarşı' and 'El-Ahsa mutfağı' need none.
Opening-hours or ticket wording on det.hoursNotice beyond the source (TM-approved pair); no prayer-time or Ramadan note on CATEGORY_LABELS.religious.
A flight, visa or road remark on foot.l.getThere, or any comparison to a place in Türkiye anywhere.
'Official' or 'verified' framing on foot.independence: the source disclaims official status, the Turkish keeps that disclaimer exactly.

termbase_proposals.suffix_vowel: i — gezilecek yerler; yere (common noun, no apostrophe)
termbase_proposals.source: tr-translation/memory/tm.json: published 'gezilecek yerler haritasında' (jabal-al-qarah); TDK gezilecek is a regular participle

termbase_proposals.suffix_vowel: ı — common phrase, no apostrophe: El-Ahsa mutfağında
termbase_proposals.source: derived from El-Ahsa (termbase, P2) + TDK mutfak; no Turkish attestation of a 'Hasawi' form

source_defects.defect: ar has an extra clause not in en ('من الأماكن التراثية في الأحساء إلى متاحف الأحساء'); en is the translation source, the Turkish follows en.

The suggest-bar strings are written from the viewpoint of the page being offered ('available in <this language>'); on a Turkish frame they only make sense if a Turkish counterpart of a non-Turkish page exists. Not a text defect; flagged for wiring.
ar is 'واحة الأحساء في اليونسكو' (Al-Ahsa Oasis at UNESCO) while en is only 'UNESCO World Heritage'; Turkish follows en. The label does not claim the link is about El-Ahsa.
